description: This file contains utility functions for working with syntax trees, including finding enclosing type declarations, extracting top-level declarations, and unwrapping nodes to base types, primarily used in code analysis or tooling.

methods.name: findEnclosingTypeDeclaration
methods.description: Finds the type declaration (type alias, interface, enum) enclosing a given position in source code.

methods.name: extractTopLevelDecls
methods.description: Extracts top-level declarations from a file using a language-specific query.

methods.name: extractFunctionTypeFromDecl
methods.description: Constructs a string representing a function's type signature from a query match.

methods.name: unwrapToBaseType
methods.description: Recursively unwraps a syntax node to its base type.
